title: Heart failure, home with home health; list and star ratings given but referral sent to affiliated agency with no choice documented; pending labs have no owner

rationale.pac_choice: A list was given, but nothing says the patient was told he could choose or which agency he chose; the referral went to the hospital-affiliated agency.
rationale.pending_results: TSH and A1c are listed as pending, but no one is named to follow them up.
rationale.pac_list: A list of Medicare-certified home health agencies was provided.
rationale.pac_quality_data: Care Compare star ratings were printed on the list given to the patient.
